id.description: id for the input. Label and hint ids are derived from this.

name.description: name attribute for the input. Defaults to id.

hint.description: Hint text displayed below the label.

error.description: Error message. Renders aria-describedby and error styling.

defaultValue.description: Initial date (yyyy-mm-dd). Sets data-default-value on the usa-date-picker wrapper.

minDate.description: Earliest selectable date (yyyy-mm-dd). Sets data-min-date on the wrapper.

maxDate.description: Latest selectable date (yyyy-mm-dd). Sets data-max-date on the wrapper.

rangeDate.description: Companion date (yyyy-mm-dd) used to highlight a range on the calendar. Sets data-range-date on the wrapper.

className.description: Additional classes for the usa-date-picker wrapper.
